meta.name: pua-trae
meta.description: Trae-optimized PUA high-agency governance skill for npx skills installs. Use only for explicit PUA requests, repeated failures, user frustration, giving-up/passive behavior, or unverified completion. Do not trigger for normal first-attempt tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用高能动性治理模式处理安装失败与用户挫败
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在npx安装技能时处理反复失败和用户被动行为
copy.tagline_en: Handle install failures and user frustration with high-agency governance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle repeated failures and passive behavior during npx skill installs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你遇到困难时主动诊断问题、列出证据、执行验证，并输出包含结论、证据和自我审查的交付报告，确保任务真实完成。
howto.when: 当你明确要求“再试试”或“换个方法”，同一任务失败两次以上，或你表现出放弃、被动行为时触发。正常首次请求不启用。

say.text: 再试试，换个方法解决这个问题。
我快放弃了，你帮我搞定。
say.note: 激活高能动性治理模式。

say.text: 验证一下刚才的改动是否真的生效。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude proactively diagnoses issues, lists evidence, runs verification, and outputs a delivery report with conclusion, evidence, and self-review when you encounter difficulties, ensuring tasks are truly completed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to 'try harder' or 'try another way', the same task fails twice or more, or you show signs of giving up or passive behavior. Not triggered for normal first-attempt requests.

say_en.text: Try again, use a different approach.
I'm about to give up, you handle it.
Verify if the recent change actually works.
